title: Spacious House close to Nashville
description:
The whole group will enjoy easy access to everything from this centrally located place, 15 mins to BNA airport, and 25 mins to downtown Nashville.  Located between Percy Priest Lake and Old Hickory Lake.

The space
The 2-story guesthouse is on private property, with an outdoor patio, that sleeps up to 10, an open layout, a rec room, and parking big enough for a truck and boat.

Guest access
Full Access to the guesthouse.

Other things to note
Each room is equipped with ceiling fans, smart TVs, and a fully equipped kitchen.
